description: Extract one supplied HTML document into machine-readable evidence and cross-check it against itself. Returns title, metadata, canonical, robots directive, JSON-LD, resolved links, tables, readable text and content hashes. Reports a canonical that disagrees with the URL served, an Open Graph title that disagrees with the document title, a noindex directive, and absent title, description or structured data. Scripts are not executed and nothing is fetched. Pay 140000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

html.description: The document to read. Raw HTML, at most 262144 bytes. Scripts are not executed, so anything rendered client-side is absent and said to be absent. Nothing is fetched: the caller supplies the bytes, which is what lets an arbitrary site be audited.

include_markdown.description: Include the readable text. Defaults to true. Set false when only the structured fields and hashes are wanted.

url.description: The URL the document was served under. Used to resolve relative links and to compare against the declared canonical. A wrong value produces wrong resolutions rather than silently relative ones.

name: html_evidence_pack

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

complete_evidence.description: True only when the whole document was parsed and every cross-check passed. Not a quality score.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the markup and of the readable text, with byte and character counts, so a later snapshot can be compared without storing the page.

links.description: Resolved links with their text, the total, and how many left the host.

metadata.description: Meta values keyed by name or property, including Open Graph and Twitter entries.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

structured_data.description: The JSON-LD blocks, their count and the distinct @type values.

tables.description: Tables as rows of cells, with the count.

title: HTML Evidence Pack
